headline: Too much of this common nutrient could be accelerating blood vessel aging
reason: Researchers have identified a kidney protein that regulates blood phosphate levels. A deficiency in this protein accelerated vascular aging and shortened lifespan in animal models, while reducing dietary phosphate helped alleviate damage. This discovery provides a human-centric insight into vascular aging and an actionable protocol (dietary phosphate reduction) for potentially slowing this process.
